exposure: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in mothers
outcome: Presence and duration of serum HBsAg and HBeAg in newborns
cohort: The study included 101 newborns from 98 HBV-infected mothers.
finding: While antigenemia without viremia was often transient in newborns of HBV-infected mothers, concurrent HBV viremia and antigenemia requires attention as one infant developed active hepatitis and required liver biopsy.
